Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!
Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:
We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries
We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities

We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.
The role
You will lead the Decisioning squad as its most senior data scientist: data scientists, ML engineers, and backend engineers across Stockholm and India, reporting to the Associate Director, Revenue Intelligence, in Stockholm.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will still write models, run the offline evaluations, and read the experiment results yourself. You will also set the modelling direction for the squad, decide which problems are worth solving next, and hold the bar on how a model earns its way into production.
The work has a direct commercial edge. The squad's models decide which ads run and at what price on Truecaller's largest ad surfaces, so a better model shows up in revenue within weeks. The next step is to move from choosing the campaign to setting the bid: one decision that combines a calibrated conversion probability with price, pacing and frequency.
What you'll do
Own the modelling roadmap for decisioning - conversion prediction, ranking, campaign selection and bidding - and agree it with product and engineering.
Design, build and run production models end to end, from problem framing and features through offline evaluation, A/B tests and monitoring.
Evolve the contextual bandit from choosing which campaign to show to setting a per-request bid, with exploration, off-policy evaluation and safe rollout built in.
Keep model scores honest: calibration per campaign and placement, and a clear link between offline metrics and the revenue and conversions advertisers actually see.
Set the bar for experimentation in the squad: every model change ships with a holdout, an agreed success metric, and a clear ship or kill rule.
Lead the squad: set the technical direction, review designs and code, run the prioritisation, and grow the data scientists, engineers and interns around you. You are accountable for what the squad ships, not only for your own work.
Write the RFCs and decision records the group works from, and present results and trade-offs to product, commercial and executive leadership.
Work with backend and data engineering on serving latency, feature pipelines and data quality, so models run reliably at very high throughput.
Raise the data science practice across Revenue Intelligence and the wider discipline through reviews, shared methods and mentoring.

What you bring in
7+ years in data science or applied machine learning, including several years owning models in production that real revenue depends on.
Depth in ranking, recommendation, or conversion prediction at scale - multi-task learning, deep learning, gradient-boosted models, and calibration.
Hands-on experience with online learning or decision systems, such as contextual bandits, exploration strategies, and off-policy evaluation.
Strong experimentation skills: A/B test design, power, causal reasoning, and telling a real lift from noise.
Expert Python and SQL, with a modern deep learning framework (TensorFlow/Keras or PyTorch) and a cloud warehouse at real scale. We run on GCP and BigQuery; equivalent depth on another stack transfers.
Technical leadership of a team: setting direction, reviewing other people's work, and raising the quality of the people around you.
Strong written English. You will write the RFCs, evaluation reports, and design docs, and they will be read by people who were not in the room.
Comfort operating across Stockholm and India time zones.

It would be great if you also have
Ad tech experience - real-time bidding, auctions, pacing, attribution or campaign delivery.
Experience with the India digital advertising market and performance advertisers.
An MSc or PhD in computer science, statistics, mathematics, or a related field.
Experience taking models to low-latency serving, and the MLOps around it: model registries, monitoring and automated retraining.
Exposure to privacy-constrained modelling, such as GDPR and India's DPDP Act.
Experience applying LLMs to modelling or analysis work.

The research group focuses on improving diagnostics and advancing our understanding of central nervous system (CNS) tumours through epigenetic and molecular approaches. Our research particularly focuses on DNA methylation profiling, nanopore sequencing, and the analysis of patient-derived samples, including liquid biopsies. We combine advanced sequencing technologies with bioinformatic method development and multiomics analyses to develop new diagnostic and prognostic tools and gain deeper insights into tumour biology. Close collaborations with pathologists, neurosurgeons, and oncologists at Sahlgrenska University Hospital support the group's strong translational research focus. 
Duties 
We are seeking an experienced and independent researcher with strong expertise in bioinformatics and a particular interest in computational method development within cancer research. The position focuses on developing and applying advanced bioinformatic methods for sequencing data analysis, with particular emphasis on nanopore sequencing, epigenetic modifications, liquid biopsy, and integrated multiomics analyses.
The successful candidate is expected to independently develop novel computational methods and bioinformatic pipelines and contribute to the design and execution of research projects within the group.
Responsibilities include:
Independent development, implementation, and optimisation of bioinformatic methods and computational pipelines for large-scale sequencing data.
Development of analytical methods for DNA methylation arrays and nanopore sequencing data, including the identification and quantification of DNA methylation and other nucleic acid modifications.
Development and application of bioinformatic methods for liquid biopsy analysis, particularly cell-free DNA (cfDNA), using nanopore sequencing and enzymatic methyl-seq (EM-seq).
Development of computational approaches for the analysis of RNA modifications from sequencing data.
Integration of genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic data through advanced multiomics analyses.
Development of robust and reproducible computational pipelines, including evaluation and validation of novel analytical methods.
Independent statistical analysis, visualisation, and biological interpretation of complex datasets.
Scientific responsibility for the bioinformatic aspects of research projects, including study design, methodological decisions, data interpretation, and scientific publication.
Collaboration with experimental and clinical researchers, as well as supervision of junior researchers and students in bioinformatics.

 
Qualifications 
Required qualifications
PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, or another relevant discipline with a strong computational focus.
Several years of documented experience in independent bioinformatic research and computational method development.
Extensive expertise in the analysis of large-scale sequencing data, particularly DNA methylation arrays and nanopore sequencing.
Documented experience in developing and implementing bioinformatic methods and computational pipelines.
Experience in bioinformatic analysis of DNA methylation and other epigenetic modifications.
Experience in the analysis of liquid biopsy data, RNA modifications, and/or integrated multiomics datasets.
Excellent programming skills, for example in Python and R, and experience working in Linux-based computational environments.
Demonstrated ability to independently design, conduct, and lead bioinformatic research projects.
A strong scientific publication record in relevant research areas.
Excellent written and spoken English and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary research environment.

Meriting qualifications
Experience in bioinformatic analysis of liquid biopsy data using nanopore sequencing and EM-seq.
Experience in developing methods for identifying RNA modifications from nanopore-based direct RNA sequencing.
In-depth knowledge of epigenetics, DNA methylation, and epigenetic tumour classification.
Research experience in CNS tumours or other areas of cancer research.
Experience in integrating genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic datasets.
Experience with high-performance computing (HPC), version control, and reproducible computational workflows.
Experience in translational research and the development of bioinformatic methods for diagnostic applications.

Employment 
The position is temporary, 11 months, full time and is placed at the Institute of Biomedicine. First day of employment as agreed.

Join us in shaping the future of digital manufacturing at Nobia Park!
At Nobia Park, we're building one of Europe's most modern manufacturing environments. Our factory combines advanced automation, digitalization, and lean operations to create a highly efficient and future-focused production setup.
We are now looking for a MES Solution Architect to play a key role in designing, developing, and evolving the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions that support our production and logistics operations.
This is a unique opportunity to join a large-scale transformation journey where technology, processes, and people come together to create the factory of the future.
Where we are right now
Nobia is in one of the most exciting phases in its history. As part of our transformation journey, we are continuously developing the digital capabilities that support our highly automated production environment at Nobia Park in Jönköping.
As production volumes continue to increase and new capabilities are introduced, the need for scalable, integrated and business-driven MES solutions becomes even more important. We are therefore strengthening our MES organization and expanding our internal capability to design, develop, and support solutions that create value across manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, and supply chain operations.
About the role
As a MES Solution Architect, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting business-critical MES solutions that enable efficient and reliable operations across the factory.
Acting as the bridge between business processes and technical execution, you will ensure that solutions are scalable, integrated, and aligned with both business objectives and architectural standards.
The role combines solution architecture, stakeholder collaboration, process development, and continuous improvement in a highly automated manufacturing environment.
Your responsibilities

Translate business requirements into scalable and effective MES solutions, ensuring alignment with both operational needs and architectural standards.

Design and support integrations between MES, SAP S/4HANA, production equipment, and other business-critical systems.

Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, MES Solution Engineers, and external partners throughout the design, development, testing, and implementation lifecycle.

Contribute to the evolution of MES architecture, development standards, governance, and future ways of working.

Drive continuous improvement initiatives, support incident management, and contribute to increased operational efficiency, system stability, and production performance.

Location: Nobia Park, Jönköping. This is an on-site position.
Who you are
To succeed in this role, you are a proactive and collaborative professional who enjoys working where manufacturing processes and technology meet.
You have the ability to understand operational needs and translate them into sustainable system solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, engaging with stakeholders across different functions, and driving improvements that create measurable business value.
You are comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving and thrive in an environment where technology plays a critical role in operational success.
Most importantly, you are motivated by being part of a transformation journey where your expertise will help shape the digital manufacturing landscape of one of Europe's most advanced production facilities.
We believe you bring

5+ years of experience working with MES solutions in manufacturing environments, preferably within highly automated production facilities.

Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, MES architecture, and system integrations across MES, ERP (preferably SAP S/4HANA), machines and shop floor technologies.

Experience with C#, T-SQL, Microsoft SQL Server, relational databases, and industrial communication standards such as OPC UA.

Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Fluency in Swedish and English.

It is highly desirable if you have

Experience with Insight2020.

Experience working in Agile development environments.

About Nobia
Nobia is Europe’s leading kitchen specialist and part of everyday life for millions of people, with the kitchen playing an increasingly important role in modern homes. The Group consists of eighteen strong brands, including Marbodal, HTH, Sigdal, and uno form.
At Nobia, you will have the opportunity to be part of a modern manufacturing environment where you can make a real impact. We offer a dynamic workplace with excellent opportunities for both personal and professional growth, giving you the chance to influence the way we work and the results we achieve. Our culture is built on safety, collaboration, and a continuous drive for improvement.
Curious to learn more? Visit Nobia Park.
Want to be a part of our journey?
Then we would like to receive your application later than December 13.
We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Our recruitment process is competency-based and includes assessments to provide both you and us with the best possible conditions for a successful match.
As part of the employment process, you will need to demonstrate your right to work within the EU, for example through a passport or a valid work permit. Background checks and drug screening may be conducted as part of the recruitment process. A six-month probationary period can be applied.
For questions regarding the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist josephine.tjernlund@nobia.com
We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

jobs.description:
Mälardalen University (MDU) is the youngest university in Sweden. In line with our vision, to be a progressive and collaborative University where we shape a sustainable future together, we wish to make a difference.Do you want to be involved and contribute to our development?Together, we can create a sustainable future through knowledge and innovation. We believe that knowledge and new perspectives are best attained and reached together in collaboration with others – our colleagues, students, the private and public sectors, both nationally and internationally.The Faculty of Engineering and Health Sciences provides education and conducts research in engineering, health and information design, with a clear focus on addressing societal challenges. Our research is carried out in close collaboration with external partners, both nationally and internationally, and contributes to knowledge development and innovation. Through our collaboration platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector and industry to jointly drive knowledge development and strengthen the relevance of research and education. Education at all levels is research-based and closely aligned with the needs of society and working life. Together, we contribute to sustainable societal development.The Faculty comprises three departments with a total of approximately 500 staff.The Department of Computer Science and Engineering conducts internationally recognised research in close collaboration with industry, the public sector and other higher education institutions, in areas including artificial intelligence, dependable systems, embedded systems, and medical and health technologies. The department educates students in fields such as computer science, software engineering, computer networks, applied AI, dependable systems, cybersecurity, and intelligent embedded systems.
Employment information
 
Employment: Temporary employment, 2 years
 
Period of employment/Start date: March 2027 or as soon as possible
 
Scope: Full time
 
Number of positions: 1
 
Closing date for application: 2026-12-31
 
Campus location: Västerås
 
School: Datavetenskap och datateknik
Position description
The purpose of the position is to give the employee an early opportunity to develop his or her independence as a researcher and to create the conditions for further acquisitions of qualifications after completing the doctoral degree. The position is a temporary employment with a maximum period of 3 years. 
As postdoc in the Chips-JU uPQComing project, the candidate is expected to lead their line of research, both individually and in collaboration with other project members, both at MDU and in the consortium. The tasks involved in the employment include also co-supervision of PhD students, project meetings, participation and presentation at research venues as well as project reporting events. The postdoc is expected to teach for 10% of their employment time.
Qualification requirements
The applicant is required to have a PhD in Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or Quantum Computing
The applicant must have completed the degree no more than three years before the end of the application period. You have not previously held a position as a postdoctoral researcher in the same or related subject area at MDU that exceeds one year.
Documented research in quantum computing is required. The candidate shall demonstrate advanced skills in conducting both research and implementation tasks (e.g. first-/single-author publications, own GitHub repository, etc.). Written and oral communication skills: demonstrates the ability to communicate ideas clearly and persuasively, both in writing and orally. This includes the ability to articulate complex concepts in accessible language during one-to-one meetings and presentations to both small and large groups. Requirements for employment are the ability to teach and conduct research in English.
This position involves work within a research project where access to certain research results, methods, technical systems, software or other information may be regulated by export control, security or sanctions legislation. The successful candidate must therefore be able to meet the requirements set out in the relevant legislation in order to gain access to the project’s research environment and to be able to carry out the duties of the position. A security clearance or other legally justified checks may be carried out if the nature of the position requires so.  
Assessment criteria
For this position, particular emphasis will be placed on: 
Documented knowledge and research in (post-)quantum cryptography and/or cybersecurity is considered a merit
Knowledge of digital-twins is considered a merit
Documented collaborations with researchers outside their own supervision team and/or with industry are considered a merit

Job description: Are you an experienced finance professional who wants to work close to senior management, gain broad exposure across a global organization and take the next step in your development?
 It all starts with people. People like you.
 Join our team
 We are now looking for a Divisional Controller to join the Drilling tools division (RGD) Finance team. This is a key role supporting the VP Controlling & Finance and the divisional finance organization, combining financial control, consolidation, performance management and business analysis.
 The role provides broad exposure across RGD’s global operations, with the opportunity to work with Customer Centers, Product Companies, Distribution Centers and other parts of Epiroc. You will join an experienced finance team and collaborate closely with Business Lines, controllers and finance colleagues across regions.
 Your mission
 As Divisional Controller, you will have a central role in ensuring high-quality financial reporting and supporting divisional performance. The role combines financial controlling with business controlling, from closing and reporting to performance analysis and forecasting.
 The role requires you to move between financial details and the bigger picture, and to help management understand what is behind the numbers.
 Your main responsibilities will include:
  Coordinate and participate in divisional monthly, quarterly and annual closing and review processes, including adjustments and eliminations, and ensure consistency across P&L, balance sheet and KPIs.
 Analyze reporting from operational units and ensure high-quality, timely financial information.
 Analyze divisional performance and identify key drivers behind deviations from plan, forecast and prior years.
 Coordinate forecasting and planning across the division, collaborating with controllers across regions and operational units to improve forecast quality.
 Partner closely with the VP Controlling & Finance and support management with analysis and financial insights.
 Support strategic initiatives, business cases, investments and profitability improvement programs, and participate in cross-functional projects.
 Contribute to developing reporting, dashboards and analytical tools and identify opportunities to simplify and automate ways of working.
  
 
  
Profile description:Your profile
 You are curious and analytical, with an eye for detail and the ability to step back and see the bigger picture. You enjoy collaborating across functions and cultures, are comfortable sharing your perspective and listening to others, and take responsibility for following up on what has been agreed. We believe that you have a genuine interest in how automation and AI can help us work smarter in finance.
 You have a relevant university degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field, and you will likely bring around 5–10 years of experience from financial controlling, business controlling, FP&A, business finance or a similar area.
 We believe that you bring:
  Experience working in a global or matrix organization.
   Strong Excel skills and experience with ERP and reporting systems.
   Experience using Power BI or similar data visualization and reporting tools, with the ability to interpret and analyze the information they provide.
 Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.
  
Experience from controlling within production, supply chain or distribution and from consolidation systems such as Tagetik or similar is an advantage.
  
  
We offer: 
 Location and other
 The position is preferably based in Sweden, at one of our Epiroc offices in Sickla (Stockholm), Örebro or Fagersta. Occasional travel might be required.
 We can offer a hybrid workplace—a way of working that provides flexibility and promotes a healthier balance between professional and personal life.
 Why Epiroc?
 By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact.
 To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:
  Global career opportunities
 Learning & Development programs
 Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)
 Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
 Global Parental Leave Policy
 Community involvement
  
Application and contact information
 We encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than 4/12 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date.
 We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.

About the role 

Are you interested in combining your technical expertise in the automotive industry with a role where you can take ownership, coordinate development activities, and drive technical functions forward? We are looking for a Senior Sensing Function Owner to join our client in Gothenburg, an international technology company developing advanced active safety systems for the automotive industry.

In this role, you will take ownership of a specific function within camera-based sensing systems and ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems). You will collaborate closely with software development teams, testing and validation engineers, and other technical stakeholders to ensure that the systems meet defined requirements and deliver the expected performance.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of technology, coordination, and leadership, taking responsibility for technical deliveries without necessarily having formal personnel management responsibilities.

The position starts as a consultancy assignment through Maxitech, with the intention of transitioning into direct employment with the client after an initial period.


You are offered

•	A technically challenging position where you contribute to the development of next-generation active safety systems in the automotive industry.
•	An international working environment involving collaboration with development teams and customers across different regions.
•	Opportunities to develop your skills in technical leadership, systems engineering, and advanced automotive technology.

Your responsibilities

You will be responsible for driving and coordinating the development of a specific function within camera-based sensing systems. Acting as a technical function owner, you will play a central role in ensuring that requirements, development, testing, and delivery are aligned throughout the development process.

You will coordinate multiple teams and technical disciplines, both locally and internationally. The role requires you to plan activities, prioritize resources, and manage technical challenges throughout the development lifecycle. An important part of your responsibility is to ensure that the function's performance is verified through testing, data collection, and analysis.

You will work in a dynamic environment where several projects and product generations may run in parallel. This requires clear communication, strong coordination skills, and the ability to drive progress despite changing priorities.
Your main responsibilities will include:

•	Take ownership of a specific technical function throughout the development lifecycle, from requirements definition and planning to verification, validation, and delivery.
•	Coordinate and lead activities involving software developers, testing and validation teams, data collection teams, and other technical stakeholders.
•	Analyze, define, and follow up on technical requirements, ensuring traceability between requirements, development activities, and test results.
•	Plan and follow up on testing activities, data collection, and performance verification, while driving troubleshooting and continuous improvements.
•	Manage technical issues, prioritize deviations, and ensure that the function meets agreed requirements, performance targets, and delivery timelines.


Your profile

We are looking for someone with a strong technical interest and experience in systems engineering, function development, or technical coordination. You understand how complex technical systems are developed, tested, and validated, and you enjoy taking responsibility for aligning different teams toward shared objectives.

We believe you have:
•	A bachelor's or master's degree in electronics, automation, mechatronics, computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field.
•	A few years of relevant experience in systems engineering, function development, verification, or a similar technical role.
•	Experience leading or coordinating technical activities and collaborating with multiple development teams or stakeholders.
•	Experience in requirements management, technical documentation, and system verification and validation.
•	A good understanding of development processes and how different technical functions interact within complex systems.
•	Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

It is considered an advantage if you have:
•	Experience in the automotive industry, particularly within ADAS, active safety, camera-based systems, or sensor technologies.
•	Experience with Computer Vision, radar, sensor fusion, or related technical areas.
•	Knowledge of Automotive SPICE (ASPICE), ISO 26262, or other relevant standards and development processes.
•	Experience in testing, data collection, regression testing, and performance verification.
•	Experience with tools or technologies such as MATLAB, Python, C/C++, CANoe, or CANalyzer.
•	Experience working in agile development environments and technical project coordination.
•	Swedish, Korean, German, Polish and/or French language skills or experience collaborating with international development teams.

Understanding of logistics operations, operational processes and how parcel flows connect with systems and services.
Ability to structure complex product information, documentation, requirements and master data.

Analytical, solution oriented thinking that turns product knowledge into practical improvements.

jobs.occupation: Frontier Fellow - Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description:
The most valuable product development happens where the product meets reality. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you work at that intersection: you turn AI agents into production-ready customer solutions and bring what you learn back into the product.
We call this role a Frontier Fellow: part senior engineer, part trusted technical advisor and part bridge between our customers, delivery teams and the HiveAI product team. HiveAI is Fellowmind's agent platform.
About the role
You belong to the HiveAI product organisation, but you will do much of your work alongside our implementation teams and customers.
Building one agent is easy now. Building agents a business can rely on every day is not. That's where you come in: you take on the hardest problems in our customer projects and solve them.
The job doesn't end when the solution works. You turn what you learn into HiveAI: when relevant, functionality, patterns and components built for one customer become reusable capabilities that help the next customer and everyone else.
What you will do
Fix the hard parts. Step in where agents meet real business systems, identity and users, and make them work. When shared components fall short, build your own.
Get AI agents into use, fast. Work with our delivery teams from the first customer conversation to go-live. Put a working first version in front of users within days.
Be a front runner. Help customers and Fellowmind teams make sound architecture decisions, challenge approaches that won't scale and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
Shape HiveAI. Share recurring requirements and architectural insights with the HiveAI development team.
Raise the bar for everyone. Share knowledge, patterns and best practices so implementation teams can deliver HiveAI successfully on their own.

What you might build
An agent that takes over a whole task, like handling supplier invoices or preparing quotes, and asks a person when a decision is needed.
An agent that works across ERP, CRM and the intranet on behalf of the person who asked.
A team of agents that share one business process, handing work to each other.
The tools, MCP servers and integrations they need.

Who are you?
You are an experienced engineer who enjoys being close to both the technology and the customer.
You can't stop building agents, and you want people to actually use them. You'd rather show something that works than a design document. You make good decisions without all the information, and you're as comfortable in a customer workshop as in a code review.
You bring:
Coding agents such as GitHub Copilot as your everyday way of working, and the judgement to know which generated code will hold up in production.
At least 4 years of professional software development experience, with strong skills in at least one programming language and solid engineering habits: branches, pull requests and tests
Experience taking software into production, where security, reliability and performance matter.
Practical knowledge of AI models and agents: how they behave, what they cost, how to measure them with evals.
Working knowledge of Azure, Entra ID, On-Behalf-Of and least privilege.
Direct customer-facing experience, from technical discovery and workshops to architecture discussions and communication with senior stakeholders.
A good understanding of modern product development, including when customer-specific functionality should become a reusable product capability.

Nobody ticks every box. If you're strong in several of these and know where to find help for the rest, we'd like to hear from you.
What is HiveAI?
At Fellowmind, we're building HiveAI, a platform for developing, deploying and operating AI solutions at scale. It gives enterprises a secure and scalable foundation to move beyond isolated experiments, so AI becomes part of how the business operates.
At its core is the HiveAI Agent Platform, built on Microsoft Azure, which runs AI agents securely and at scale. Around it sits the HiveAI Agent Lifecycle, which helps organisations develop, manage and continuously improve their agents over time.
Why Fellowmind?
Fellowmind combines deep industry knowledge and personal guidance with Microsoft cloud technology across ERP, cloud infrastructure, data & AI, CRM, intranet and Modern Workplace. We are an international organisation with more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe.
Our culture is built around putting people at the heart of what we do. We value collaboration, personal responsibility, development and the freedom to find a sustainable balance between work and life.
The practicalities
Start: As soon as possible, and of course we'll take your notice period into account.
Scope: Full-time.
Location: This role can be based in Sweden, Denmark or the Netherlands, from one of our Fellowmind offices.
Travel: You will work with regional teams and customers across Fellowmind, so travel is a natural part of the role.
Language: Professional proficiency in English and the local language of your country of employment: Swedish, Danish or Dutch.
Process: We start with a screening interview, followed by in-depth interviews, assessments or case work, and reference checks.
